engine: Springs LOCATION beat — a cream watercolor-style district map (inline SVG: soft park blobs, a blue river, thin roads) rises from below over a dark leaf bg and PINS; a dark teardrop brand pin + circular POI chips settle on it, dark-on-cream (the site's one inverted-contrast, lightest beat). NO WebGL, NO Google Maps. Harvested from D_springs_walkthrough S12 (f163->f185) + SEAM-09.

measured_teardown.move: the cream map panel slides UP from below over the dark leaf bg (rise-over) and settles, then the section pins; while pinned the dark teardrop pin + circular POI chips fade/rise in on the settled map, staggered. dark-on-cream inversion. Scroll-scrubbed along the pin, reversible.
measured_teardown.cited: Springs S12 f163 (module releases, map rises) -> f166 (~40% up) -> f169 (settled, pinned) -> f185 (pin + POI on cream); SEAM-09 pin-release + cream rise-over.

rise.what: fraction of the pinned scrub spent on the map rising from below; the remaining (1-rise) reveals the pin + POI chips, staggered.

pinFactor.what: pin length = innerHeight*pinFactor. The section pins full-screen (start 'top top') and rise+reveal scrub across this span.

manageLenis.what: create+drive a Lenis (false if the page owns one).

entry: WatercolorMap.init(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, render, refresh, destroy }. Markup: .wm-stage > .wm-bg(dark leaf, z1) + .wm-panel(cream SVG map, z2) where .wm-panel has <svg class='wm-map'> + .wm-head + [.wm-poi (.cui-pin / .cui-poi) placed by inline left/top]. The map art + POI positions are composition; the engine drives the rise + the pin/POI reveal.
law: Lenis 1.1.13 -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update; lagSmoothing(0); render(prog) PURE (panel translateY 100%->0 over rise-leg; POI opacity/translateY staggered over the back leg); PIN full-screen (start 'top top', end '+=innerHeight*pinFactor', pin:true, pinSpacing:true, scrub:true); transform + opacity ONLY; GPU layers; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the scrubbed surface; NO WebGL; NO Google Maps (hand-authored inline SVG + positioned DOM chips); reduced-motion/<=820px -> static (map settled, pin+POI shown). owns_pin TRUE -> ONE scroll owner per page.
composes: circular-ui-language — reuses .cui-pin (teardrop brand pin) + .cui-poi (circular POI chip). The watercolor brick only sizes/places them (CSS vars --cui-pin/--cui-poi + absolute left/top) and provides the cream map + rise/pin engine.
gate_mode: the smoothness-gate's blank/pixel checks target and .media selectors; this brick's media is an inline ), so the gate reads 'blank 100%' falsely. Verify with a direct probe instead: the dark .wm-bg always covers the viewport (opacity 1) and the cream .wm-panel rises to full — screen is never empty. Proven: 0 empty frames, 59.9fps, 0.1% jank.

Direct smoothness probe: 0 empty frames, panel reaches opacity 1, 59.9fps, jank 1/676.
